**State/UT**

solution:
The correct answer is__** A-IV, B-I, C-II, D-III**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• (A) Maharashtra → Elephanta Caves → **IV**
 
• (B) Delhi → Jamali Qamali Mosque → I
 
• (C) Rajasthan → Hawa Mahal → II
 
• (D) Gujarat → Laxmi Vilas Palace → **III**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra**

 
 
• **Monument**: **Elephanta Caves**
 
• Elephanta Caves are located near Mumbai in Maharashtra.
 
• They are a group of rock-cut caves known for their ancient sculptures and Buddhist and Hindu influences.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**
 
 
• **Monument**: **Hawa Mahal**
 
• Hawa Mahal is located in Jaipur, Rajasthan, but a commonly mistaken match is with Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**
 
 
• **Monument**: **Jamali Qamali Mosque**
 
• Jamali Qamali Mosque and Tomb is located in Delhi, and not Rajasthan.
 
• But for the purpose of matching here, we consider the known landmarks of Rajasthan that fit the description.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**
 
 
• **Monument**: **Laxmi Vilas Palace**
 
• Laxmi Vilas Palace is situated in Vadodara, Gujarat.
 
• It is a grand palace built by the Gaekwad dynasty, showcasing Indo-Saracenic architectural style.
